mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer WHERE transfer_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND operator_user_id=#{actor} AND BINARY client_request_id=BINARY #{key}

SELECT t.*,CASE WHEN r.transfer_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END reversed FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer t LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_overtime_transfer r ON r.original_transfer_id=t.transfer_id AND r.action='REVERSE' WHERE t.source_day_result_id=#{sourceId} AND t.action='APPLY' ORDER BY t.transfer_id DESC
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer WHERE bucket_id=#{bucketId} AND action='APPLY'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer WHERE original_transfer_id=#{id} AND action='REVERSE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_profile p ON p.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=u.dept_id AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' JOIN sys_dept shop ON shop.dept_id=#{shopId} AND shop.status='0' AND shop.del_flag='0' WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND p.legal_entity_id=#{legalEntityId} AND (d.dept_id=shop.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(shop.dept_id,d.ancestors)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept owner JOIN sys_legal_entity le ON le.legal_entity_id=owner.legal_entity_id AND le.status='0' WHERE (owner.dept_id=shop.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(owner.dept_id,shop.ancestors)) AND owner.status='0' AND owner.del_flag='0' AND owner.legal_entity_id=#{legalEntityId}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_hr_lifecycle_action WHERE employee_id=#{userId} AND action_type='TRANSFER_CONFIRMED' AND business_status='CONFIRMED' AND (effective_date IS NULL OR effective_date>=#{sourceDate})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_attendance_day_result d JOIN oa_attendance_schedule s ON s.schedule_id=d.schedule_id WHERE d.day_result_id=#{sourceId} AND s.status='PUBLISHED' AND s.user_id=d.user_id AND s.shop_id=d.shop_id AND s.business_date=d.business_date

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer t JOIN oa_attendance_day_result d ON d.day_result_id=t.source_day_result_id JOIN oa_attendance_schedule s ON s.schedule_id=d.schedule_id AND s.status='PUBLISHED' WHERE t.transfer_id=#{id} AND t.action='APPLY' AND d.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND d.row_version=t.source_version AND d.schedule_id=t.source_schedule_id AND d.user_id=t.user_id AND d.shop_id=t.shop_id AND d.business_date=t.source_business_date AND d.worked_minutes=t.source_worked_minutes AND d.scheduled_minutes=t.source_scheduled_minutes AND d.settled_at=t.source_settled_at AND s.user_id=t.user_id AND s.shop_id=t.shop_id AND s.business_date=t.source_business_date AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer r WHERE r.original_transfer_id=t.transfer_id AND r.action='REVERSE')
